observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher adopts a persona, using a casual and encouraging tone to guide the viewer. He breaks down the movements into simple, manageable steps while emphasizing the importance of practice.

lesson_structure.note: The teacher introduces himself as Batman and explains the purpose of the video.
The teacher explains the hand movements for the Batusi.
The teacher demonstrates the arm movements.
The teacher incorporates the cape into the dance.
The teacher adds the leg movements.
The teacher performs the full dance to music.

common_mistakes: Incorrect hand placement for the Batusi

steps_taught.name: Batusi hand movement
steps_taught.description: Two fingers up near the eyes, moving in a circular motion.

steps_taught.name: Arm movement
steps_taught.description: Arms held straight and moving in a rhythmic, crossing motion.

steps_taught.name: Leg movement
steps_taught.description: Raising one leg at a time while jumping.

what_works: The teacher breaks down the movements into simple, manageable steps.
The teacher provides clear visual demonstrations of each step.
what_hinders: The teacher's costume, specifically the mask and cape, can sometimes obscure the movements.
The lack of a clear counting scheme might make it difficult for some learners to follow the rhythm.

quotes.text: It's all about concentrating on the moves.
Don't do this. You've got to do this.
Most people assume they'll do that, not at all.
If you want to touch it for beginners, you can.

evidence_segments.observation: The teacher stands in front of the camera and speaks directly to the audience.
The teacher demonstrates the hand movement by placing two fingers near his eyes.
The teacher demonstrates the arm movement by crossing his arms in front of his chest.
The teacher incorporates his cape into the dance by holding it and moving it.
The teacher demonstrates the leg movement by raising one leg at a time.
The teacher performs the full dance to music.

extraction.distinctive_method: The teacher uses a character persona (Batman) to teach the dance, which adds a unique and entertaining element to the tutorial.
